heading: When to use it
text:
### When to use it [LNRE.2.3]

| Goal | Setting |
|---|---|
| A program that will never need regex, targeting a footprint-constrained runtime | `regex: false` |
| A program that may add regex later, or targets a runtime with no image-size constraint | `regex: true`, as `default` has it |

`regex: false` is a promise about the program's content, not a
requirement for deployment: a regex-free program runs on a regex-less
runtime either way ([LNRE.1.3]). Set it to get the promise checked at
compile time instead of discovered at load time.
